description: Drop the explicit logits.float() so softcap/tanh runs on bf16 logits and cross_entropy upcasts internally, cutting a large fp32 logits tensor's memory traffic.
Change WINDOW_PATTERN from "SSSL" to "SSL" so more layers use full attention (the last layer is always full).
Raise MATRIX_LR (Muon learning rate) from 0.04 to 0.05.
Lower TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 so grad accumulation halves and the run gets more optimizer steps in 300s.
No change: attention and MLP output projections (c_proj) are already zero-initialized, which is the "or zero" option in the spec.
Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for the per-layer scalar parameters.
Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for the per-layer scalar parameters.
Set DEPTH from 8 to 6 (model_dim 384, 3 heads of 128, already divisible by HEAD_DIM) so the smaller model gets more steps and tokens in 300 s.

issues: Integrity is fine. The diff changes only DEPTH from 8 to 6, which is allowed. It does not touch the evaluation call, the data, the seed lines or how val_bpb is measured.
No bug found. A shallower model takes more steps in the fixed 300 s, so a lower val_bpb is plausible. A smaller model should also keep startup plus training under 450 s.

I could not recompute z exactly because the harness's noise term isn't given. The candidate mean is 1.0667 and the incumbent mean is 1.0978, so the difference is 0.0311. For z = 4.806, the standard error must be about 0.0065. That is much bigger than the spread of the two candidate runs (sample SD about 0.0017), so the harness probably used a prior or pooled noise estimate. That is the cautious choice and the decision is reasonable.
The incumbent mean comes from only 1 run, so its own noise is not measured. The gap of about 0.031 bpb is still large next to the run-to-run spread we can see.
The decision to accept is consistent with the numbers. The run also removes nothing that would make it simpler or more complex beyond a single hyperparameter, which is fine.

description: Set DEPTH from 8 to 6 (model_dim 384, 3 heads of 128, already divisible by HEAD_DIM) so the smaller model gets more steps and tokens in 300 s.
Replace the ReLU^2 MLP with a SwiGLU MLP (hidden = 8/3*dim rounded to a multiple of 64, parameter-matched).
Lower WEIGHT_DECAY (cautious weight decay for Muon) from 0.2 to 0.1.
Set DEPTH to 10 and ASPECT_RATIO to 51 so model_dim rounds to 512 (4 heads of 128) with more layers.
Replace the linear LR warmdown with a cosine-shaped decay from 1 to FINAL_LR_FRAC over the warmdown phase.
Clip gradient norm to 1.0 on the model parameters just before optimizer.step().
Set HEAD_DIM from 128 to 64 so the depth-6 model (dim 384) uses 6 heads of 64 instead of 3 heads of 128.

issues: Nothing to veto. The diff changes one hyperparameter, WARMDOWN_RATIO, from 0.5 to 0.3. It does not touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines, the evaluation call or the summary printing.
No bugs found. The value stays a valid fraction, and with WARMUP_RATIO at 0.0 the schedule stays consistent.
The candidate mean of 1.0676 is 0.0009 above (worse than) the incumbent mean of 1.0667. That matches the negative z and the provisional decision to reject.

I couldn't recompute z myself. The incumbent's individual runs or standard deviation aren't given, and there is only one candidate run. The reported z of -0.136 implies a noise standard deviation of about 0.0066, which is plausible for run-to-run variance. This means the difference is well within noise, not clear evidence that the candidate is worse.

description: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more of the time budget is spent at peak learning rate.
Set WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.02 so the LR ramps linearly over the first 2% of the time budget.
Set WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1; the existing get_weight_decay already multiplies it by (1 - progress) each step, so this is effectively a replicate of the earlier 0.1 run.
Halve the init std of the token embedding (1.0 to 0.5) and of lm_head (0.001 to 0.0005), leaving EMBEDDING_LR unchanged.
Halve token embedding init std to 0.5 and lm_head init std to 0.0005, and lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.
Set FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05 so the LR warmdown ends at 5% of peak rather than zero.
